notes: Projects in the sidebar switch shows its list again after Tasks, Vault or Inbox. Once the project list had been shown, switching to it from one of those three left their list where it was, and only Chats led back to it. Reported by Brad.

Inbox Watch can keep the Pocket Inbox label in your Gmail inbox: with [gmail_label] inbox = true, a thread that gets the label is also put back in your inbox, so an alert on mail your filters file away (an alarm ticket, a monitoring report) shows in both places.

Inbox Watch no longer stops overnight. Since 1.75.3, an email it chose to alert you about during quiet hours ended the check with an error, and the alert was lost. A check that fails part-way now leaves its emails to be judged again, instead of counting them as already told.

Inbox: the dot beside an alert says whether you have read it (orange, or a ring once read) and taps to mark it read or unread. An alert you started a conversation from shows a speech bubble that opens that conversation, and its options offer Open the conversation before Start another. Suggested by Damon.
Projects in the sidebar switch is now a flag, a goal with a next step, so no two entries share a shape. Suggested by Damon.

The Vault, Files and Codex transcripts close four faults Casey found while re-checking 1.73.2: a public or share link no longer follows a symlink that replaced the stored file; a key rotation that stopped half-way is rolled back at start, so a passphrase set and later removed never moves the Vault to a key you were not shown; a Codex command keeps its exit code when a transcript page arrives late; and a Vault audit row that failed part-way no longer hides the next one.
